input.body: The change to use a mutable default argument in the `collect` function can lead to unexpected behavior. When the function is called multiple times without providing a new list, it will continue to append to the same list, which can cause data leakage between calls. This is a common pitfall in Python. Please change the default value of `items` back to `None` and handle the list initialization inside the function.
